verses.text: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God [is] good to Israel, to those pure of heart.

segments.text: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God [is] good to Israel, to those pure of heart.

verses.text: And [as for] me, at a little stretching out of my feet, my steps had nearly poured out.

segments.text: And [as for] me, at a little stretching out of my feet, my steps had nearly poured out.

verses.text: For I was envious of those boasting [when] I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

segments.text: For I was envious of those boasting [when] I saw the prosperity of the wicked.

verses.text: For there are no pangs until their death, and their body [is] fat.

segments.text: For there are no pangs until their death, and their body [is] fat.

verses.text: They [are] not in the trouble of mankind, and with men they are not are they plagued.

segments.text: They [are] not in the trouble of mankind, and with men they are not are they plagued.

verses.text: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence is a covering for them.

segments.text: Therefore pride is their necklace; a garment of violence is a covering for them.

verses.text: Their eye has bulged out from fat, the imaginations of their heart overflow.

segments.text: Their eye has bulged out from fat, the imaginations of their heart overflow.

verses.text: They scoff and speak with malice; from a high place they speak oppression.

segments.text: They scoff and speak with malice; from a high place they speak oppression.

verses.text: They have set their mouth in the heavens, and their tongue walks through the earth.

segments.text: They have set their mouth in the heavens, and their tongue walks through the earth.

verses.text: Therefore his people turn here, and waters of fullness are wrung out for them.

segments.text: Therefore his people turn here, and waters of fullness are wrung out for them.

verses.text: And they say, “How can God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?”

segments.text: And they say, “How can God know? And is there knowledge in the Most High?”

verses.text: Behold, these [are] the wicked, and at ease always, they have increased in wealth.

segments.text: Behold, these [are] the wicked, and at ease always, they have increased in wealth.

verses.text: Surely [in] vain I have cleansed my heart, and I have washed my hands in innocence.

segments.text: Surely [in] vain I have cleansed my heart, and I have washed my hands in innocence.

verses.text: For I have been stricken all the day, and chastened in the morning.

segments.text: For I have been stricken all the day, and chastened in the morning.

verses.text: If I had said, “I will speak like this,” behold, I would have betrayed the generation of Your sons.

segments.text: If I had said, “I will speak like this,” behold, I would have betrayed the generation of Your sons.

verses.text: And I thought to know this—it [was] toil in my eyes—

segments.text: And I thought to know this—it [was] toil in my eyes—

verses.text: until I came to the sanctuary of God, [and] discerned their end.

segments.text: until I came to the sanctuary of God, [and] discerned their end.

verses.text: Surely You set them on slick ground; You make them fall to destruction.

segments.text: Surely You set them on slick ground; You make them fall to destruction.

verses.text: How they have become a desolation in a moment! They are swept away completely by terrors.

segments.text: How they have become a desolation in a moment! They are swept away completely by terrors.

verses.text: As a dream from awakening, O Lord, in rousing Yourself, You shall despise their image.

segments.text: As a dream from awakening, O Lord, in rousing Yourself, You shall despise their image.

verses.text: For my heart had grown sour, and my kidneys pierce themselves.

segments.text: For my heart had grown sour, and my kidneys pierce themselves.

verses.text: And I [was] brutish and could not know; I was a beast before You.

segments.text: And I [was] brutish and could not know; I was a beast before You.

verses.text: And I [am] always with You; You hold my right hand.

segments.text: And I [am] always with You; You hold my right hand.

verses.text: May You lead me with Your counsel, and afterward You will receive me [in] glory!

segments.text: May You lead me with Your counsel, and afterward You will receive me [in] glory!

verses.text: Who [is] unto me in the heavens? And besides You I do not take delight on the earth.

segments.text: Who [is] unto me in the heavens? And besides You I do not take delight on the earth.

verses.text: My flesh and my heart may be consumed, the rock of my heart and my portion [is] God to the age.

segments.text: My flesh and my heart may be consumed, the rock of my heart and my portion [is] God to the age.

verses.text: For behold, those far from You will perish. You destroy everyone prostituting himself from You!

segments.text: For behold, those far from You will perish. You destroy everyone prostituting himself from You!

verses.text: But I—the nearness of God [is] good for me—I have placed my refuge in the Lord YHWH, to recount all Your works.
